lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six distinct vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the pectoral fin. The centroids are arranged in a grid-like formation with three to five visible spots per vertical column in the mid-lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like alignment where blobs act as nodes within the vertical striations.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the superior third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity pixels on the dorsal side and a localized shadow region immediately ventral to the ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Densely packed, low-diameter high-luminance spots are visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin. A remora is attached to the ventral-lateral region just posterior to the pectoral fin trailing edge.
